title: Better search ranking
body:
Search returns matches in id order, so the task the owner is looking for is often on page three.

- Rank results: exact id match first, then title matches, then spec and message matches; ties by most recent activity.
- Keep a fixture file of 30 real queries with the expected top result and add a test that requires at least 27 of them to rank the expected result first.
- Add a benchmark; the change must not make a 50k-message search more than 20% slower.

requirements.title: Rank search results by match field and recency
Query fixture with 30 expected top results
